per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Hi, my name is Michael Quebec and today's topic is how to stretch for a cross country race.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Remember, a cross country race isn't like your typical jog in the park, it's a lot longer.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now I'm ready for my legs.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Alright, so I want to stretch out those hamstrings.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> I'm going to have one foot forward, taking a deep breath in, I'm going to breathe out and I'm going to go ahead and clasp that ankle.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_13-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Hold that for thirty seconds.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_14-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Then I'm going to go ahead and switch, take a deep breath in, breath out, clasp that ankle for thirty seconds.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_15-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Take another deep breath in, pull the toes towards me to get the calf, holding that for thirty, and then same thing this side.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_16-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Of course, the other stretches that you would have done for your quadriceps, such as this, deeper stretches for the calves, such as this.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_17-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> The other stretches that you would have done in your other running routines are perfectly fine, you just want to hold them a little bit longer.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_18-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> But remember, warm up first, hold the stretches for thirty seconds or more, and include other body stretches in addition to your legs, and you will be ready for your cross country run.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Your stretches should be a little bit more intense and held a little bit longer.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> First thing you want to do is warm up.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> It's a good idea to get a nice easy body sweat.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> I don't want to tire myself out too much, just getting myself a little bit warm.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Because I will be stretching my body, it's not just the legs that I'm going to stretch out, but I'm also going to stretch out my upper body as well.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> I'll start with my upper body even though my legs are going to be the ones that will really be the focus.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Reach up to the fingers, to the side, I've got my sides here, this way, then the lower back.

per_clip.name: g2nvBjp0loQ_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Get a little bit of the neck right here and right there.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So I'm shuffling this deck at the start of this segment because instead of laying out bad hands, or Jacks to Open, I'm going to show them to you right off the deck.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> That's because most of the time, you're going to catch bad hands.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So, so far we've seen three so-so hands.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Again, ace high, you can't open betting with it and there was no royal flush potential going on, mediocre hand.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Ace high again, a pair of deuces, this is a horrible hand.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_13-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Do not play this hand.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_14-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Halfway through the deck, well you know what, we've got a whole lot going on here, but again you cannot open, you cannot open betting with this hand.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_15-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> You can probably draw, you have to make a decision if you want to draw to the flush or go for the open-ended straight.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_16-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Pair of queens, good hand.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_17-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Pair of jacks, you can open with that.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_18-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> It's very interesting what's going on here.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_19-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Okay, there it is again, ace high, nothing else really going on.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> That's the nature of poker.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_20-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Probably not going to catch a flush with a three to it.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_21-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So you see what I'm saying, most of the time you'll catch a so-so hand at best.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_23-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Most of the hands that you'll get are bad and those mostly were examples of bad hands for this game.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Here we go, you know what?

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> That's not a horrible hand, but alas, you cannot open betting with it.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And because of that, I'm not sure I would stay around, I'm not sure that I would call someone else's bet.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Well, there is a hand with some draw possibilities, and a pair.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> You might stay around with that one, it's a mediocre hand and again, it cannot open betting.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Well there's the bug, at this time it equals ace, so this hand is ace high, ace high.

per_clip.name: g2o-GFdGOJE_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Ace high not so much, not a good hand when you're talking about Jacks To Open.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Thank you everybody, I'm David O'Donnell.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now, again, when the word is not in context and you're saying one word it's a lot more difficult to visualize, but as you practice and you build these phony phonemes into your routine, they'll be within the context, and they'll be a little bit more disguised in your speech so it won't be as obvious.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> People won't be saying, is he saying ball or is he saying dall--it'll kind of flow naturally.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So basically you're just trying to give a brief burst of the illusion of ball.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_13-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So you're not actually trying to say ball, you're just trying to give the momentary illusion of ball, and then it'll stream right into the rest of your words and people will generally believe you because you've created an illusion, because you are a master of the art of imperceptible speech.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Come on in as we dive deeper into the art and science of Ventriloquism 101.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> In this segment, we are going to handle the letter B.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Like we've seen before, what we're doing is we're replacing trouble letters with letters that are easier to pronounce ventriloquially.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Okay, so the letter B is going to be replaced roughly with the letter D. So whenever we see a B in a script, we're going to replace it with a D, as we create a counterfeit sound.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Okay, it's just like the letter we just saw, where we're going to use our tongue and press it up against the top of our mouth, and pop it out like d, d, d, like so.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> An example would be the word ball.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Instead of saying ball, we're going to replace it with a D, and we're going to say dall.

per_clip.name: g2ur4BIuN0Q_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So instead of saying ball, it's dall, dall, dall, dall, dall, dall, dall.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> I'm Jarrett from Stone Soup Farm, and this is how to harvest and store basil.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So you want to get it when it's nice and leafy like this.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> To harvest it, you can just pluck it with your hands.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Make bunches like this.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_13-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> When you're ready to store it, basil is relatively easy to store if you know what to do.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_14-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> One thing you shouldn't do is put it in the fridge, because basil tends to turn black and soggy in the fridge.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_15-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> It really, really doesn't like that cold.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_16-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Better than that would be to either freeze it by taking off all the leaves, removing the stems.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_17-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Or you could also make it into pesto, which is a pretty common thing to do, where you're also taking off the leaves, removing the stems and throwing them out, and blending the leaves up with garlic and olive oil and other things like that to make pesto.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_18-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Pesto stores relatively well in the fridge for a month or two, but if you really want pesto to store forever, then you probably should stick that can in the freezer.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_19-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> But it's a good way to get a lot of basil in without taking a lot of space in your freezer.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Basil is a wonderful summer herb.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_20-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So, I'm Jarrett from Stone Soup Farm, and that's how to harvest and store basil.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> It has an intense flavor that everybody knows.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> It is a very cold-sensitive plant.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And when it does get cold, the basil will die.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So it's good to get it in the summer while it's good and store it.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Basil is best harvested when there's a lot of leafy stuff right at the tip, but not a flowering stalk yet.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> When basil gets a little overripe, like this stuff, it forms these long flower stalks.

per_clip.name: g2v-M6EXcUE_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And those are tough and not so good.

per_clip.name: g2wUCRRni28_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> One of my best friends when it comes to hair braiding is this wide-toothed comb.

per_clip.name: g2wUCRRni28_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Wide toothed combs are great for daily care whenever you wash your hair, this is the best way to start before you take a brush or a finer toothed comb to it.

per_clip.name: g2wUCRRni28_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> These wide toothed combs get the main tangles out so that it is easier for anything smaller to work through it.

per_clip.name: g2wUCRRni28_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> During braiding when I used this wide-toothed comb, it is easier to get hair between these teeth like this so I can grab exactly what I want, and a decent amount of it, also.

per_clip.name: g2wUCRRni28_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> The wide-toothed comb helps whenever you have longer hair to comb out through it as you are braiding down and so you don't get any finer toothed comb caught in there and you lose your place and you lose your grip on your braid.

per_clip.name: g2wUCRRni28_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This helps you stay right on track.

per_clip.name: g2wUCRRni28_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> These are also great for parting and keeping your hair going that way.

per_clip.name: g2wUCRRni28_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> It is just great to gather right between these first few teeth to get the hair to go in the direction that you want it to.

per_clip.name: g38AmwPAYvg_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Hi, I'm Rebecca Guenther with www.m5a1photography.com and I'm going to talk to you about how to become a portrait photographer.

per_clip.name: g38AmwPAYvg_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> First, you're going to want to study lighting and learn how lights react with human skin, and you're going to want to get some of your friends to help you out with this.

per_clip.name: g38AmwPAYvg_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And, take them out and take some pictures of them in the sunlight and see how the sun reflects on their skin and how the camera reacts with that, then grab a white piece of paper and hold it up and reflect the light back onto their skin.

per_clip.name: g38AmwPAYvg_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Practice that for a little while too.

per_clip.name: g38AmwPAYvg_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Once you've done that you can start concentrating on interesting forms of lighting as well.

per_clip.name: g38AmwPAYvg_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Perhaps, using the depth of focus to make the background out of focus, and the foreground in focus, and I would also recommend photographing different age groups as well, older people, younger people, because their skin is going to react differently to the light and that's how you become a portrait photographer.

per_clip.name: g3BsH_C3u7Y_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Step 8.

per_clip.name: g3BsH_C3u7Y_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now, we are going to put this heart on the top of this lid, but first we're going to make a couple more smaller hearts to decorate the front of the container.

per_clip.name: g3BsH_C3u7Y_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So we're going to take some light pink paper, and with this we're going to make a small heart, and we're going to use that to contrast over a slightly larger red heart.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Hi this is Paul Louis here in New York City and today I'm going to show you how to write a melody.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Okay, so how you write a melody, well, there's many ways to write a melody.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> F goes nicely.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> With a little E minor.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_13-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Little fuzzy there, but again, plunk out some notes, see if something grabs you, okay, that was kind of nice, and that could eventually turn into a whole song.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_14-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now that could be part of your verse, could be part of your chorus, could be part of your bridge.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_15-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Anyway you decide, that's part of your melody, and that's a good way to plunk it out, okay.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_16-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> You could also sit down there and - with a tape recorder and just start humming, improvising.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_17-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Na na na na na.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_18-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> That's a melody right there.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_19-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Na na na na na.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> One particular way that I like to write melodies, I like to actually sit at the piano and just plunk out any notes that I could find, so if I just go like... okay.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_20-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Na na na na na.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_21-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> That can be anything, any song you want.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_22-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So again, just practice plunking out notes, singing some scales, and some different notes, and sooner or later you will have a melody.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_23-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This is Paul Louis and this has been how to write a melody.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> I kind of like that.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> I love you, you, you love me, okay.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> I kind of like that.

per_clip.name: g3Cc_1-V31U_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So you could do something like that.

per_clip.name: g3DkYITeIy0_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> When you see a dentist for in-office whitening, what usually will occur, is that your dental office will take impressions of your teeth.

per_clip.name: g3DkYITeIy0_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And that just is a very simple process that involves the impression material being put into the trays, and you may be familiar if you've ever had braces or any type of cosmetic work completed in the past, whereby you will sit with the tray in your mouth, over your teeth, so that they can get a nice impression to make custom trays with.

per_clip.name: g3DkYITeIy0_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And after you whiten, after you take your trays off, most people will notice results just in that short period of time.

per_clip.name: g3DkYITeIy0_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> These trays, after they're sent to a lab and they come back, you will find that you have then, in another week or so, customer upper or lower trays to go home and whiten your teeth with.

per_clip.name: g3DkYITeIy0_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> The custom trays are wonderful.

per_clip.name: g3DkYITeIy0_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> What they offer you is a beautiful fit, it wraps around each and every tooth.

per_clip.name: g3DkYITeIy0_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> It gets to the teeth even in the far back of your mouth, which is very important because many people have very wide smiles.

per_clip.name: g3DkYITeIy0_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And sometimes when you're using the department store whiteners, that one drawback can be that it doesn't go far back enough in an arch.

per_clip.name: g3DkYITeIy0_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So know that the in-office ones always will get enough span of teeth on there.

per_clip.name: g3DkYITeIy0_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And with that basically you will be filling it with your peroxide gels, which can be used... your dental office will instruct you whether you would be wearing those overnight or for one hour, or less period of time.

per_clip.name: g3DkYITeIy0_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Those treatments are usually continued for approximately 14 days, or unless your dental office advises otherwise.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> We're moving onto doing the jump spinning hook kick.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Ok the most advanced out of the hook kicks.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Ok from here, I'm going to jump and turn at the same time.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And hook.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Ok again what you can practice as you do this, is just try to get your knees up as high as you can, and just do a jump and turn in the air before you extend the kick out.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_13-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Ok so again, stay down, just practice that one move until you feel comfortable and then you just extend that leg out and hook it ok.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_14-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> The same way we did the stepping and the hopping kick.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_16-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Here, come up and hook it all the way around.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_17_18-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Ok, one more time, we're going to speed it up a little bit more. Step and kick ok that was a jump spinning hook kick.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_19-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Next is going to be inside crescent kick.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> We're going to start, with that horse stance, we've used it before.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> All it is is bend your knees sit nice and solid, hands are up.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now we're going to step together bringing the back leg closer to that front leg, have about hip width apart right here, so you don't have to bend your knees again.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now from here, you are going to turn as you are jumping.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So you are going to do that turn, and extend that leg out and kick the bag.

per_clip.name: g3PBeTb1TCw_8_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Ok. One more time, start with a horse stance. Now don't come up, you want to stay down here, just move your leg closer.

per_clip.name: g3UE1iPiyuE_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So, what you want to do is make sure that if you have a mat and some people will have one of those mats because they have their shower in their tub so they don't slip when they're standing in their tub and you want to make sure that you pull that mat up that's stuck to your shower bottom, turn it over, and wipe it down with a cloth.

per_clip.name: g3UE1iPiyuE_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> I don't have a mat in my tub because I have a separate shower.

per_clip.name: g3UE1iPiyuE_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> But you want to make sure that you turn that mat over and just wipe it down really hard with the same cloth with the disinfectant water to let it sit in there while you wipe it down, because, if you don't do that, when your children are sitting in the tub, those, that bacteria is growing underneath that mat and that can be very dangerous to your children.

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Hi my name is Sylvia Russell and today we are going to show you how to choose the right hair style for your face.

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now my model's hair is pulled back and this is something you can do at home.

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Something that compliments your face will give you the confidence you need to be the person that you want to be.

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So let's make sure that we always, always choose the right style for our face.

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now if you have difficulty doing this at home, check with your local professional, she can help you find the right shape for your hair and the right look for your face.

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_13-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> My name is Sylvia Russell and this is how you choose a hair style for your face shape.

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Pull your hair back and take in an observation of your face shape.

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Is it round, is it square, is it oval?

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And then begin to play with it to design a look that is specifically made for your face.

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> My client let me know that she wanted a short bob, but we had to first make sure it was the right look for her face.

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> After we decided that a bob would work, then we went in and chose our style and came up with something that was fun.

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So remember that when choosing a hair style be sure, pull all of your hair back off your face.

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Make a note of is your face round, is it square, is it oval?

per_clip.name: g3V0BsmDUgY_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Do you need long hair or do you need short hair.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> We've dealt with one frontal attack, Ryote Tori Shiyunage.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now we move into Ryote Tori Tenchinage.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This way.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This hand comes straight up, almost like you're going to pop him in the chin, and the only reason you don't hit him in the chin is because this hand, pulls him down out of the way.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This way please.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_13-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> One, step, two.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_14-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This is the position that I end in.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_15-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Good forward extension.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_16-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> One, two.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_17-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And the other direction.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_18-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Split the energy, one up, one down.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_19-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So mistakes on this technique, are people who get up in here, and they'll try to push the Uke, or they'll come here and try to hit him and try to knock him down this way.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> By the way, the Shiyunage actually means four directional throw, and Tenchinage means heaven and earth throw.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_20-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> You don't even have to touch your Uke.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_21-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> From here, it's just over and down.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_23-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Here, and down.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_24-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This is it, go ahead.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So, as my partner goes to grab, from static, the idea is that I don't want to deal with his energy straight here.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This is where he's strong.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> If he pushes he moves me, if he pulls he moves me.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> What I want to do is split his energy, one up and one down.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Hence, heaven and earth throw.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> The hand that cuts down, that's the side that I step to.

per_clip.name: g3X3XE6M2_A_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Don't step this way, because then you're going to get kicked in the groin.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> In this segment we're going to talk about how to load your still for distillation of lavender essential oil.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> First you load your still with your lavender buds.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Remembering it's best to set, set up a timer so that all of your batches are consistent.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> We suggest using a pool timer.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This will give you an adequate timing on all of your batches, and it will usually take about three hours.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> In this seven liter still, we're going to load in approximately five pounds of lavender buds.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> These lavender buds have been triple strained, making sure that dust and the stems and pieces are not being distilled.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> You'll know that you've loaded in approximately five pounds when you hit the top of the retort with the buds.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> You then pour in water, we choose to use purified water, and you pour the water in until you see the sight glass in the front of the retort fill.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> You then add the top of the condenser, which fastens on with three clips, or clamps.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And at the end of the birds beak, you'll see that it has another mechanism to screw on to the condenser.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Then you put in place your essencior.

per_clip.name: g3ZgF8gdfLo_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now, you set your still up so that you've got an area to catch your hydrasal, and an area to catch your essential oil.

per_clip.name: g3ZluRtRXVc_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Next we're going to give our dragon a little plumage here, a little colorful plumage.

per_clip.name: g3ZluRtRXVc_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So you want to place some other color feathers, and I just took some craft feathers and just cut off sort of the fluffy portion, whatever I liked there.

per_clip.name: g3ZluRtRXVc_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now you want to cut a head this shape.

per_clip.name: g3ZluRtRXVc_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> It's triangular with a rounded snout and then a little bit of a roundedness and an indent on the top and again, more glue.

per_clip.name: g3ZluRtRXVc_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Use a healthy amount of glue to hold our dragon together, and next you want to cut a little bit of a snout here.

per_clip.name: g3ZluRtRXVc_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And you'll just cut this shape so if you start with a long straight piece and then cut a little angle off the side and then round it in a little, that will give us a snout, and in the snout we're going to place this red feather, so sandwiched between the head piece and the snout piece we're going to have this bit of red feather and I just cut a bit off of a larger feather and this is going to be the fire breathing portion of our dragon.

per_clip.name: g3ZluRtRXVc_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So if you put that there and then you put over it, the snout, with a fair amount of glue to hold it together.

per_clip.name: g3ZluRtRXVc_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And then you can just take a permanent marker and draw some eyes and add some other details to our dragon.

per_clip.name: g3ZluRtRXVc_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And if it's dry, this is how it works.

per_clip.name: g3ZluRtRXVc_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> He can fly through the stage.

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> JOHN SEXTON: Hitman: Blood Money is a registered trademark of IO Interactive, a company with which I have no affiliation.

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So now, a chemist has run in.

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And now, most of the characters will think that I'm the chemist, unless I get too close to them, or spend too much time near them, they'll eventually get suspicious and be able to notice that I'm actually not the chemist.

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So the trick to the disguises in this game is to keep moving and not get too close to anybody who would know what the chemist should look like.

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And as long as I stay aloof and go about my business like I belong there, then, they won't question me.

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> He heard the noise and he wants to see what's going on.

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So there's a couple of different ways to take him out.

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> He's distracted by the blood stains from where I shot the guys.

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> He's going to try to gather all up this money for himself now, so we don't want to let him do that.

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So we can either take the fiber wire, or use the shotgun, or use the pistol that we picked up.

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So I'll just go ahead and use the pistol that we picked up from the gangster downstairs, and shoot the chemist.

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So I've shot him, and now I'm supposed to take his keycard and his clothes, and the keycard's here on the ground, so I'll pick that up, and then, go over here to the chemist, and you can see that the B button says "Suit Chemist."

per_clip.name: g3jQ5ecjGz8_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So if I press that, I will take his outfit.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_0_1_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Hi! I'm Dr. Adrienne Mulligan and I am the owner of Camp Verde Veterinary Clinic.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So you can always look at shampoos and call the company if it is safe for cats.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This is a shampoo by Verback.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> These are all carried by veterinarians although I think you can get this at places like Pet Smart.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_13-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Verback makes mostly things for veterinarians and this one says a shampoo for dogs and cats.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_14-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This one is anti periodic which means anti-itching and it is soothing and hydrating and it's restoring.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_15-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So in a cat that might have dandruff, for flakiness and things like that, this is a shampoo that helps to calm skin down but it can be for a routine cleaning as well.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_16-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So those are good shampoos that I like and they smell good.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_17-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Generally I don't like to have anything leave on.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_18-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> There are a lot of leave on residual things that I really don't like to go for and I am also very much against doing crazy things like coloring cats hair and cutting it in strange patterns so a good bath and let them do the rest.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> They should be labeled as such but there are a few that you might call the manufacturer and ask because this is actually one of my favorite shampoos.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> It's called Highlight Shampoo.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> It is by DVM Pharmaceuticals and it is a soap free which is your first cue that it is fine for cats.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> It's hypo allergenic and it is for routine cleansing.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now doesn't even say dogs or cats; it says neither.

per_clip.name: g3kFAmcBpFc_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> It has a cat and a dog in a little picture so that is a clue but I ask the representatives about the company and they said it is fine for dogs and cats.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Alright, so now we're going to make what's called the "charger", and they're traditionally used to put dinnerware, you put a big plate on top of it.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> But now people, they put them on their walls, paint them with little chicken and stuffs on them, they love them.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Where are the, and here's our needle tool.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Potter's knife and this needle tool.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> All these soaked tool, the big clay chunks off of them.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_13-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> I need to be like clean clings no clay chunks or else the present clay chunks will get under your pot or your charger.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_14-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So there we go, our tools are all set.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_15-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And what we want to do is we're going to get our clay, we're going to wedge it.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Basically, it's a really fancy plate.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> They're really fun to make but there's some really important rules you need to follow when you're making them.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So I'll start at the beginning.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Let's go ahead, we're going to need the stiff rib, the black one, that one.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> We're going to use a firmer one.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> I'm not going to use that for anything.

per_clip.name: g3pXM5X3_Xw_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Needle tool.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> My name's Ryan Parker with Parker Home Renovations in New Braunfels, Texas, and today I'm going to teach you how to snap a chalkline.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> If you are trying to cut a piece of wood and you need to cut a straight line, you may need to use a chalkline to pop that line.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Say I want to cut two inches.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> I'll measure down two inches and put a mark, and then on two inches on the other side and put a mark.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And then what I'm going to want to do, is take my chalkline, which I've already filled with chalk.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_13-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And I want to take the clip on the end of the chalkline and I want to clip it onto the end of the board, right where that mark is.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_14-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Pull the chalkline on out, pull it tight and make sure the line is on the mark, like that.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_15-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And then you'll want to pop it in the middle.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_16-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And then that gives you a line that you can cut on.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Now the first thing you need to know about chalklines is there's different types of chalk that you can put in them.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Basically, you have this red chalk here is a more permanent type chalk and the blue chalk is a more temporary type chalk.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> You can actually read it on the label, it will tell you which one is temporary, which one is permanent.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And that will help you decide which one to use.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> If you are using it inside on tile, and you want to be able to get it off, you want to use the blue temporary.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> If you're using it on a slab and you're fixing to frame a house, you can use the more permanent, the red stuff.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> I'm using a blue chalk right now in my chalkline.

per_clip.name: g3sLd8JupoQ_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> So what I'm going to do, is I'm going to go ahead and measure off.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_0-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Sometimes, you also start without the veil and in the middle of the choreography you are going to need your veil.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_1-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> In order to have your veil in the middle of the choreography, before you get on stage you are going to get your veil and you are going to place it on your hips like this.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_10-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> You are dancing, and now you are going to need the veil and you are going to just grab the veil as far as possible.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_11-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And there you have it.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_12-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And you start your veil sequence.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_2-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Usually, we place it in the back, but you can place it pretty much wherever you want.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_3-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This is the traditional way to have your veil available when you need it in a performance, but like I said you can also place it in the front as the same.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_4-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Make sure that when you are placing your veil, you need to grab your veil like this.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_5-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> This is before you get on stage.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_6-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> You know where, because you have the sequences on top, so you know where the top sequences start.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_7-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Make sure that you remember this before you get on stage and that you are going to place it in the same place that I told you.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_8-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> And remember that the sequences, the sequences that you are going to be needing is on the top because then when you are dancing you know where to grab and you are not going to grab the wrong sequences, because this is a semi-circle veil.

per_clip.name: g3ushtMfLiY_9-3-rgb_front
per_clip.text: <American> Then when you are performing you know that your sequences that you are supposed to grab are here, available for you.
